name: SynXAI-Data
description: Eleven synthetic tabular classification datasets (100,000 instances × 49 features) in which every row carries its own ground truth: the features of the rule that generated its label. Includes trained models, the Additive Feature Restoration validation outputs, and per-instance attributions from four explainers (SHAP, LIME, Anchor, LORE). Generation is deterministic under a single seed. Accompanies the paper of the same name; see MANIFEST.md for the mapping from files to tables and figures.
